import ComponentStates from "../../../../../components/ui/ComponentStates.astro";

Shown on a device that is already signed in, when another device nearby asks to sign in. The
person sees three 6-digit codes and taps the one the new device shows (number matching). Tapping
another code, or Not now, denies. The outcome says whether the new device is signed in, or not on
the network. The account menu's "Approve a nearby device" entry opens the same prompt.

The kits that draw it follow in their own packages; the states and copy below are the contract.
